note.zh-TW: 台灣用語，IFRS 沒有單一對應名詞；教材列出的來源與用途標「舊制分類」，教學以現行公司法與 IFRS 為主（設計說明見 T16）。
note.en: A Taiwanese term with no single IFRS equivalent; the sources and uses listed in the course are marked as the older classification, and teaching follows the current Company Act and IFRS (see the design note T16).

definition.zh-TW: 股東投入超過股票面額的部分，以及其他不是來自營業的權益增加。本課的故事沒有用到。
definition.en: The part of shareholders' contributions above par value, and other increases in equity that do not come from operations. The course story does not use it.
